how: (1) tests/support/dry_run_write_recorder.py runs each lane script as __main__ under a CPython audit hook (PEP 578) that records every write-mode open, filesystem mutation, socket connect/getaddrinfo, subprocess and sqlite3.connect, with the cron line's live switches added before --dry-run; no DB / TELEGRAM variables in the environment. (2) scripts/n8n_run_executor.py --once (the real executor; real allowlist entries with locks moved to a scratch dir; the real registry from the code root) drains a LIVE request per lane from a scratch ledger; the stage clamp runs it dry_run. Scratch state root; no DB, network or host store touched. The same proof runs in CI as the wave's test file.

recorder.stdout: DRY-RUN hermes-discovery-ingestors: would run the scheduled (--scheduled) source/trend/ticker/topic ingestors (caps from config/hermes_discovery_schedule.json, scorecard do-no-harm), upsert hermes_discovery_candidates and write the lane receipt; no env, DB, Telegram or write; inputs NOT_MEASURED

DRY-RUN youtube-cookie-health-check: would classify the YouTube cookie jar (auth-cookie count only, never values) and transcript ingestion age, alert P1 red / P2 amber through the telegram_alert chokepoint, and write the lane receipt; no env, jar, DB, Telegram or write; inputs NOT_MEASURED

DRY-RUN generate-weekly-docx: would build the weekly review (DB + state), write weekly_review_<date>.json and docx/pdf under <reports_root>/analyst (+ charts, archive/weekly/<date> copy), send one P2 notice through the telegram_alert chokepoint and write the lane receipt; no env, DB, chart, file or send; inputs NOT_MEASURED

DRY-RUN strategy-weekly-review: would review strategy_registry against strategy_signals / trade_closed, log lifecycle transitions (strategy_state_transitions, strategy_registry.status), rewrite data/portfolios/state/strategy_weekly_review_latest.json, send one P2 report through the telegram_alert chokepoint and write the lane receipt; no env, DB, log-file, snapshot, send or receipt; inputs NOT_MEASURED

DRY-RUN premarket-watcher: would scan up to 50 GO/WAIT symbols (EDGAR, StockTwits, Yahoo RSS), upsert news_articles / social_posts / trade_ai_scans / scalp_scan_results, send one P2 catalyst alert through the telegram_alert chokepoint and write the lane receipt; no env, DB, network, log-file, send or receipt; inputs NOT_MEASURED
DRY-RUN cio-stance-classification-drain: would classify pending symbols and write classification/rule rows plus receipts; inputs NOT_MEASURED
